spec_match.rationale: Maps each debugger capability to the alternatives the chromestatus summary itself names (chrome.scripting, declarativeNetRequest) and is honest about the gaps — captureVisibleTab still honouring screenshot policy, and emulation/profiling having no non-CDP replacement.

interactive.rationale: Five capability toggles drive verdict + generated manifest/fallback code; the shared attachOrFallback handler section anchors the deterministic-error pattern; copy works with an honest failure branch.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index promises alternatives, manifest permissions, and the rejection handler; all three render.

edge_cases.rationale: The 'no replacement' verdicts are explicit and prescribe honest empty-states instead of fake capability; the screenshot path notes the same policy applies to the fallback API.

conformance.rationale: Consistent with the suite's manual assertions; no page-side claim about extension APIs is made beyond the script-checked absence boundary.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP matrix both classes; autorun selects the screenshot capability and the partial verdict renders; zero console errors.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; ok/no emphasis colours used on light backgrounds at AA.

accessibility.rationale: role=group with label on the capability set, aria-pressed state, aria-live verdict, code block labelled via aria-labelledby and focusable.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Capability buttons wrap at 360; code blocks scroll horizontally inside their border without page overflow; CDP-verified both classes.

openQuestions.title: Ship the playbook as a downloadable scratch extension
openQuestions.detail: A zip with manifest + service worker implementing attachOrFallback would let a developer load-unpacked and observe the real rejection on a managed machine in minutes. Static asset, no server change needed.

guidanceConsulted.query: toggle button group selected state accessible
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use aria-pressed for toggle buttons and don't repeat state in the accessible name.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Capability buttons manage aria-pressed only; names stay stable.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data readout grid mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: flex-wrap control rows; keep code overflow inside bordered scroll containers.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Controls flex-wrap; pre.gen overflow-x:auto so page never scrolls sideways.

summary: Developer migration concept: what to ship when the 155 gate says no. Verified on both classes via CDP with autorun on the partial-support path.
